home.title: Crop insurance claims, made simple
home.subtitle: File a claim from your phone, track every step, and get SMS updates in English or Hindi. Claims are checked against real weather data so officers can decide faster.

file.title: File online
file.text: Report crop loss with photos and your farm location in a few minutes. No office visit needed.

track.title: Track every step
track.text: See when your claim is reviewed, verified, approved and paid, with an SMS at each step.

weather.title: Weather-checked
weather.text: Each claim is compared with recorded rainfall, temperature and wind at your farm, so genuine claims move faster.

track.title: Track your claim
track.subtitle: No login needed. Enter your claim number and the last 4 digits of your mobile number.
track.claimNumberHint: It is in the SMS you received, e.g. KS-2026-000012
track.phoneLast4: Last 4 digits of your mobile number

farmer.subtitle: Your claims and the weather at your farm
farmer.setLocation: Set your farm location to see the weather forecast and get weather alerts.
farmer.noClaims: You have not filed any claims yet.

newClaim.title: File a crop loss claim
newClaim.lossDateHint: Must be within the last 30 days
newClaim.descriptionHint: Optional. Describe the damage in your own words.
newClaim.bankNote: The claim amount will be paid to this account. Only the last 4 digits of the account number are ever shown.
newClaim.ifscHint: 11 characters, printed on your passbook or cheque, e.g. SBIN0001234
newClaim.photosHint: Up to 3 photos, JPG / PNG / WEBP, max 2 MB each. Optional but helps officers.
newClaim.ifscNotFound: No bank branch found for this IFSC code. Please check your passbook.
newClaim.ifscUnavailable: Could not check the IFSC code right now. You can still continue.

validation.ifsc: Enter a valid IFSC code, e.g. SBIN0001234
validation.accountNumber: Account number must be 9 to 18 digits

weatherCheck.title: Weather check
weatherCheck.explain: Recorded weather at the farm around the date of loss, compared with the reported cause. This helps the officer; it does not decide the claim.
weatherCheck.pending: The weather check runs automatically after a claim is filed.

ai.title: AI summary
ai.disabled: AI summaries are turned off on this server.
ai.disclaimer: Written by an AI model from the claim details. Always verify before deciding.

actions.title: Update status
actions.smsNote: The farmer gets an SMS about this change.
actions.notAssigned: This claim is not assigned to you, so you can view it but not change its status.

analytics.alertsText: Runs automatically every morning. Checks the 2-day forecast for every farm and sends an SMS for heavy rain, extreme heat or strong wind.

cropLimits.title: Crop limits
cropLimits.intro: Maximum payout per acre for each crop. Officers see a warning on claims above the limit. It is only a hint: the officer still decides.
cropLimits.cropHint: Same name farmers use, e.g. Paddy
cropLimits.addTitle: Propose a new or changed limit
cropLimits.twoAdminRule: Two-admin rule: any change you make is only a proposal. It takes effect after a different admin approves it, and every step is kept in the history below.
cropLimits.proposed: Change for {{crop}} proposed. Another admin must approve it.
cropLimits.approvedMsg: Change approved and now in force.
cropLimits.rejectedMsg: Change rejected. The old limit stays.
cropLimits.historyNote: Permanent record. Nobody, including admins, can edit or delete it.
